sample_size.notes: Sampled on weekly chart (same as Pipe Bottoms), not daily.

target_calculation.description: Compute formation height from highest high to lowest low of the pipe; project height downward from breakout point.

ultimate_low_method.definition: Lowest price after downward breakout before 20% reversal

failure_definition.description: Break-even failure: price fails to decline 5% below breakout (i.e., rises back above pipe).

post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_note: Median of PDF 'days to ultimate low' = ~65 days; bull 75, bear 54.

notes: PDF source: Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns (2nd ed.), chapter 36, Table 36.2/36.3.
Sample is on WEEKLY chart (consistent with Pipe Bottoms) — not daily. Failure rate at break-even (5%) is very low in bear market (2%).
BE failure 11%/2% (bull/bear) = the LOWEST in bear market among pipe-style patterns; this is a strong bearish reversal signal.
